command:
set -eu
printf '@@ BOOT_START\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '@@ TIME_START\n'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
printf '@@ LOADED_MATCHES\n'
awk '$1 == "tztv_sys" || $1 == "sdp_frc" || $1 == "tztv_frc_tcon" {print}' /proc/modules
for f in /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/*sys*.ko /lib/modules/5.4.261/kernel/soc/*sys*.ko; do
  [ -f "$f" ] || continue
  printf '@@ MODULE %s\n' "$f"
  wc -c < "$f"
  sha256sum "$f"
done
printf '@@ BOOT_END\n'
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf '@@ TIME_END\n'
date -u +%s
cat /proc/uptime
purpose: Finite passive fixed-directory provider module metadata discovery for unresolved tztv_sys_use_hdmi_cell_sw callback. No module load/getter/control/MMIO/trace. Physical panel unobserved.
